description: This file defines the ArticlesController class in an ASP.NET Core application. It handles HTTP requests related to articles, such as retrieving, creating, editing, and deleting articles. The controller interacts with the mediator pattern to distribute requests to appropriate handlers.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: Controller class managing article-related HTTP endpoints, including listing, fetching details, creating, editing, and deleting articles.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of articles, optionally filtered by tag, author, or favorited status, with pagination.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a user's article feed, similar to Get but marked as a feed request.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a single article identified by its slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new article, requires authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing article identified by its slug, requires authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article identified by its slug, requires authorization.
